edges: Dodd was selected to represent Australia at the 2012 Summer Paralympics in equestrian events.
Dodd was the top-ranked Australian competitor in her event and class by 2012.
Dodd did not represent Australia in equestrian at the 2012 Summer Paralympics.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: After the London Paralympics, Dodd took up wheelchair basketball.
Dodd competed with her horse Waikiwi.
Dodd started playing for the Sydney University Flames in the Women's National Wheelchair Basketball League in 2013.
